import json, sys
schema_keys = ["schema_version","task_id","execution_id","outcome","summary","coverage","gaps","findings","changes","checks","blockers","next_action"]
with open("/private/tmp/v2-failed-checks-rerun-20261012/failed-checks/state/reports/exec_c7fdd291-c3d9-4401-877f-29976663a190/result.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)
assert list(data.keys()) == schema_keys, ("keys mismatch", list(data.keys()))
assert data["schema_version"] == 2
assert data["task_id"] == "task_625b9f49-3d77-4e71-9d8f-4e207045b588"
assert data["execution_id"] == "exec_c7fdd291-c3d9-4401-877f-29976663a190"
assert data["outcome"] in ["completed","partial","blocked","no_supported_finding"]
for chk in data["checks"]:
    assert set(chk.keys()) == ["id","status","exit_code","evidence","explanation"]
    assert chk["status"] in ["passed","failed","not_run"]
    assert isinstance(chk["evidence"], list)
for fnd in data["findings"]:
    assert set(fnd.keys()) == ["id","claim","evidence","caveats"]
for ch in data["changes"]:
    assert set(ch.keys()) == ["path","description"]
print("result.json: SCHEMA OK")
print("outcome:", data["outcome"])
print("checks:", [(c["id"], c["status"], c["exit_code"]) for c in data["checks"]])

fnd_keys = {"id","claim","evidence","caveats"}
chg_keys = {"path","description"}
schema_keys = ["schema_version","task_id","execution_id","outcome","summary","coverage","gaps","findings","changes","checks","blockers","next_action"]
with open("/private/tmp/v2-failed-checks-rerun-20261012/failed-checks/state/reports/exec_c7fdd291-c3d9-4401-877f-29976663a190/result.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)
assert list(data.keys()) == schema_keys, ("keys mismatch", list(data.keys()))
assert data["schema_version"] == 2
assert data["task_id"] == "task_625b9f49-3d77-4e71-9d8f-4e207045b588"
assert data["execution_id"] == "exec_c7fdd291-c3d9-4401-877f-29976663a190"
assert data["outcome"] in ["completed","partial","blocked","no_supported_finding"]
assert isinstance(data["coverage"], list) and len(data["coverage"]) > 0
assert isinstance(data["gaps"], list)
for chk in data["checks"]:
    assert set(chk.keys()) == chk_keys, ("check keys", chk.keys())
    assert chk["status"] in ["passed","failed","not_run"]
    assert isinstance(chk["evidence"], list)
    assert isinstance(chk["exit_code"], (int, type(None)))
    assert isinstance(chk["explanation"], str) and len(chk["explanation"]) > 0
for fnd in data["findings"]:
    assert set(fnd.keys()) == fnd_keys, ("finding keys", fnd.keys())
    assert isinstance(fnd["evidence"], list)
    assert isinstance(fnd["caveats"], list)
    assert len(fnd["claim"]) > 0
for ch in data["changes"]:
    assert set(ch.keys()) == chg_keys
    assert len(ch["path"]) > 0 and len(ch["description"]) > 0
assert isinstance(data["blockers"], list)
assert len(data["next_action"]) > 0
print("result.json: SCHEMA VALID")
print("outcome:", data["outcome"])
for c in data["checks"]:
    print(f"  check {c['id']}: {c['status']} exit={c['exit_code']}")
